question: Is a genuinely new publicly accessible dataset described that pairs clathrin fluorescence tracks with an independently assayed same-event sealing/internalization endpoint?
rationale: Distinct measurement validation: determine whether fluorescence track disappearance predicts an assay-defined event rather than assuming it. Does not need full spatial force/load calibration; does need independent endpoint validation.
contrast: Track disappearance may coincide with assay-defined endpoint or instead reflect optical dropout/link loss; this stage tests only source feasibility, no event contrast.
required_contract: independent assay-defined endpoint, not dynamin flash or disappearance itself
time registration and possible assay lag
public data identity and explicit access status
excluded: unverified mechanical force or scission claim
stop_condition: One sourced candidate and explicit remaining contract/access gaps, or one exhausted screen with exact gap. No full-data acquisition or analysis; no retries beyond registered calls.
